name: deut_lamp
description: Packed, frozen DEUT block in an INSL box with a PRTI floor -- a stable, non-decaying light source.
why: Build-lessons 'packed DEUT is the stable non-destructive light source': DEUT has neither PROP_LIFE_DEC nor PROP_LIFE_KILL and glows once life>=240 without cooking anything; freezing it to -273C and sealing it in INSL with a PRTI floor (observed life 19464) makes it a permanent decoration light, unlike PLSM.
source: save2, exact pixel pattern x394-401 y86-96 (DEUT life 19464 at 396-399,87; PRTI at 396-399,93)
